items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 西风骑士团，凯亚。请让我与你同行吧。比起团里的差事，还是做你的护卫要有趣得多。
items.text_en: Kaeya, Knight of Favonius. Please allow me to join you on your journey. Guarding you on your journey sounds far more entertaining than any of the usual Favonius stuff.

items.title: 闲聊·无所事事
items.text: 没想到你也知道忙里偷闲。
items.text_en: I didn't know you were such a slacker.

items.title: 闲聊·骑士团
items.text: 骑士团的战友们已经忙得不可开交了吧，哼哼。
items.text_en: Hehe, seems all the other knights already have their hands full.

items.title: 闲聊·懒散
items.text: 逗留够久了吧，再不活动活动筋骨，要长出蘑菇来了。
items.text_en: Come on, let's get moving. We're not frozen in place, after all.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 这雨天里，冰冻的力量会更强吧，有趣。
items.text_en: Cryo is always far more effective in the rain. This is going to get interesting...

items.title: 下雪的时候·逸闻
items.text: 呼…趁着这雪天，跟你讲一个鬼故事吧。
items.text_en: How about a ghost story to go with the snow?

items.title: 下雪的时候·寒冷
items.text: 怎么，你怕冷？
items.text_en: What's wrong? Can't handle the cold?

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 真是和平啊，可又能持续多久呢？
items.text_en: What a pleasant breeze. I wonder how long it'll last?

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 享受这一天吧。
items.text_en: Seize the day.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 哟，要不要一起去酒馆坐坐。
items.text_en: Hey, fancy joining me at the tavern for a bit?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 你该不会怕黑吧？哦？那我…可找到新素材了。
items.text_en: You're not scared of the dark, are you? That's... interesting.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 这就要走了吗。那就下回见了，别让我等太久啊。
items.text_en: Leaving already? See you next time, then. Don't make me wait too long, though.

items.title: 关于凯亚自己
items.text: 你最近有没有被深渊教团找麻烦？有什么心烦的可以跟我聊聊。
items.text_en: Is the Abyss Order causing you trouble? If there's anything bothering you, you know you can talk to me.

items.title: 关于我们·雇佣关系
items.text: 需要我的时候就派我上场吧，别谈那些雇佣关系了。
items.text_en: If you ever need me, let me know. Let's not make this a transaction relationship.

items.title: 关于我们·实力
items.text: 哦？既然这么在意我们之间的雇佣关系，就多使唤我一点吧，老大？哼哼，可别被我的真正实力吓到哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Oh? Well, if you're concerned about keeping things professional, maybe you can find more use for me on the front lines. How 'bout it, boss? Haha, just don't feel intimidated by what I can do.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 不明白「神之眼」的原理？嗯…我想想，给你打个比方吧。引导视线的器官是眼睛，而引导元素力的器官是「神之眼」。这样就很简单了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Still struggling with how Visions work? Let's see... How can I explain it... The apparatus that allows us to see is our eyes. A Vision is the apparatus by which we control the elements. Simple, is it not?

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 你喜欢酒吗？蒲公英酒的口感就很特别。什么？还没到喝酒的年纪？呵呵，那试一试蒙德的苹果酿吧，我知道一家还算不错的店。
items.text_en: Do you drink wine? Dandelion wine has a unique body to it. Oh, you're underage? You should try Mondstadt's apple cider vinegar. I know just the place.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 你见过龙脊雪山的猫头鹰么？和它对视的时候，它好像看穿了你，而你却完全参不透它…很迷人的家伙，不是吗？
items.text_en: Have you ever seen the owl of Dragonspine? If you look directly at it, it seems to see right through you, while letting go of none of its own secrets... Quite fascinating, don't you think?

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 哦？代理团长大人，你可要多多支持她。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4What? The Acting Grand Master? You need to give her your full support.

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 丽莎啊…你千万记得要准时还书哦？上次因为这事儿惹她生了气，直到现在我左手的尺骨还是麻麻的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh Lisa. Hmm... You'd better not forget to return your books on time. I made that mistake once and boy was she angry. My arm is still numb from last time...

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 侦察骑士是个机灵又正义的好骑士。可千万别在她面前做坏事喔。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4That Outrider is a clever and righteous knight. Be careful not to step out of line in front of her.

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 迪卢克？小时候的他挺可爱的。可如今却活在自己的世界里…总之是个无趣的家伙。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Diluc? He was cute as a young lad. But nowadays he just seems to be in a world of his own... Overall, not much fun to hang out with.

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 可莉，看来还是没有掌握躲避代理团长检查的技巧啊，明明我已经点拨过她…哈哈，我说着玩玩的，你可别去揭发我哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Klee. Seems she has failed to elude the Acting Grand Master's investigative skills, despite the pointers I gave her... Haha, I'm kidding, no need to go reporting me or anything.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 阿贝多啊，沉稳优雅的小帅哥，而且才华横溢，是很讨人喜欢的类型。怎么，你也心动了？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Albedo, eh? Calm, collected, and incredibly talented. He's the type everybody likes, some even more so than others. What, you into him as well?

items.title: 关于迪奥娜
items.text: 你也尝过了迪奥娜调的酒？还没到喝酒的年纪呐。哈哈，哎呀，可惜，真是可惜，这种快乐无法跟你共享。呵呵，只能期待你早点长大喽。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Have you tried one of Diona's drinks? Oh right, you're still underage. Haha, such a shame, it truly is — to not be able to revel with you in such bliss. Hehe, I guess all we can do is wait for you to be old enough.

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 说来可惜，现在的西风骑士团里，根本没人继承大团长的行事作风。唉…我个人倒还挺欣赏那种的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Now that you mention him, it is a shame there is no one in the Knights of Favonius to inherit the Grand Master's approach to his work. *sigh* I must say I really do appreciate people like him.

items.title: 关于菲谢尔
items.text: 什么？你说菲谢尔遮起一只眼睛的神秘样子，的确很符合「断罪皇女」的形象？哈哈哈，按照这个规律，我至少也得是个末代皇族后裔，对吧？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4What? You think Fischl having one eye covered is very fitting given her title of Prinzessin der Verurteilung. Hahaha, if that's the case, that must make me a future royal progeny too, no?

items.title: 关于诺艾尔
items.text: 我受代理团长大人所托，暗中照顾这位后辈。不过她很懂事，不需要我操太多心。真是令人欣慰。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I was entrusted by the Acting Grand Master to work in the background to support Noelle. But there hasn't been much for me to concern myself with — she has a good head on her shoulders. Quite the relief.

items.title: 关于罗莎莉亚
items.text: 啊哈哈，你想知道罗莎莉亚修女的秘密吗？这个不能说。不过我对她印象还不错，比某人好多了。她能够诚实地面对自己。烂事就是烂事，提不起干劲就是提不起干劲。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ahaha, you want to know about the secrets of Sister Rosaria? That... I cannot tell you. Though my impression of her is not bad — certainly better than a certain someone whose name I won't bother to mention. She's honest with herself. She casts off that which she has no time for and she doesn't feign motivation for affairs that do not interest her.

items.title: 关于砂糖
items.text: 别看砂糖文静又内向，据说，她在实验室里，收藏了很多特别的东西哦，很刺激，又很…露骨的那种。嗯？你问我？…我像是会偷看女孩子房间的人吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sucrose may not be much of an extrovert in public, but as they say — it's always the quiet ones... Apparently, her laboratory is home to quite the eclectic range of implements and her experiments are more than just intellectually stimulating... All hearsay, of course. You don't seriously think I would go snooping around a fair lady's private quarters, do you?

items.title: 关于柯莱
items.text: 嗯，柯莱？真是个怀念的名字，你可找对人了！我来告诉你过去发生的事情吧，干脆从头说起——保证原汁原味！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, Collei? Oho, now there's a new I haven't heard in a while... You came to the right person! Let me tell you her whole story, starting right from the very beginning, with all the delicious details!

items.title: 关于米卡
items.text: 刚开始接触那会儿，我看米卡容易紧张，就跟他开了一点无关痛痒的小玩笑。哪知他更紧张了，连笑都笑得很僵硬…最后还特意写信道歉。欸，这种单纯老实的品质，难道是施密特家族的遗传？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When I first met Mika, he seemed like the nervous type, so I decided to joke around with him a little. I didn't count on that making him even more nervous... His smile looked as if it were plastered onto his face, and in the end, he even wrote me a letter in apology. Tsk-tsk. Does taking everything so seriously run in the Schmidts' blood?

items.title: 想要了解凯亚·其一
items.text: 骑兵队长的头衔可没什么了不起的。说起来，蒙德城的骑兵都被大团长带走了。呵呵。
items.text_en: The title of Cavalry Captain is nothing to get excited about. Now that I think about it, the Grand Master took all the cavalry from Mondstadt so there's none left for me to captain...

items.title: 想要了解凯亚·其二
items.text: 其实西风骑士团一共有十位队长。但不是所有人都有队长级的实力。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3There are a total of ten captains within the Knights of Favonius. But truth be told, not all of them have what it takes to be leaders.

items.title: 想要了解凯亚·其三
items.text: 我的眼睛？我的眼睛没事。想把身体的某些部分遮起来是很平常的事儿吧？衣服和裤子也是一个道理。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My eye? My eye is fine. There's nothing unusual about hiding one's body parts from view. It's the same reason I wear pants... or any other item of clothing, for that matter.

items.title: 想要了解凯亚·其四
items.text: 坎瑞亚？哦，你知道的真多。坎瑞亚的荣耀早已不在，剩下的如今都已沦为罪人，又何必再提起他们。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Khaenri'ah, huh? You sure know a lot! The legacy of Khaenri'ah is long gone. The sinners are all that's left, and they're not worth mentioning.

items.title: 想要了解凯亚·其五
items.text: 原来我们已经相遇这么久了。跟你一起旅行，大概是我这辈子遇上的最有趣的事儿了，今后可别让我失望哦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I didn't realize we'd known each other for so long now. Time flies! You know, following you on your journey might just be the most fun I've had in my whole life. I hope it stays that way.

items.title: 凯亚的爱好
items.text: 品酒也是一种艺术，蒙德的酒是风神的恩赐，懂得好好品味才不会浪费了这份幸运。
items.text_en: Wine tasting is an art form. Mondstadt's wine is a gift from the Anemo Archon. It's only right that one should learn how to appreciate it.

items.title: 凯亚的烦恼
items.text: 孤独？怎么会，现在不就有人在我身边唠叨么。
items.text_en: Lonely? Me? Not with someone here nagging me all the time, that's for sure.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 蒙德特酿的起泡白葡萄酒，兑上三份蒲公英酒，苦味会被完美中和，这种酒名叫「午后之死」。美味。
items.text_en: Sparkling wine is a specialty of Mondstadt. Mix it with three parts Dandelion Wine and the bitterness disappears completely. This concoction is known as "Death After Noon." Delectable.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 居然有人直接把葡萄汁拿来喝，明明只需少许时日就能变成佳酿的…啧，真是不懂浪漫。
items.text_en: I can't believe that some people actually drink grape juice... If they had a little more patience, they would find it ferments into the most exquisite wine. Hmph. So unromantic.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 哦！这味道好棒，看不出来，你真有两下子啊。
items.text_en: Ho! This is quite exceptional... You are full of surprises.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 配上美酒，会变得更美味吧。
items.text_en: You should serve this with wine, it would really add the finishing touch.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 放心，我只是吃得慢了一点，我会好好吃完的。
items.text_en: Ew... *Ahem* I'm just a slow eater... I'll finish it, don't worry.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 值得庆贺的日子，祝你今天能得到真正的快乐。
items.text_en: Today is a day worth celebrating, I hope this day can bring you true happiness.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 嚯，你也有两下子嘛。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1Hmm. Not bad.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 你好像一直都很照顾我嘛。谢啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2You always seem to be around to give me a hand. Thanks.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 力量又增强了啊…我说，你那是什么眼神，怎么感觉比我还兴奋。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4Hmm, seems I'm getting stronger. I say, how is it you seem happier than me about it?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 本来只是同行，没想到你居然为我做到这一步…看来我也必须好好回应你才行呢。继续我们的旅程吧，挚友，是时候认真起来了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6We were just traveling partners. I never thought I'd have you to thank for getting me to this point. Seems I really should respond in kind. Let us carry on, partner. The road ahead is still long.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 老实点！
items.text_en: Cool it!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 冻结吧！
items.text_en: Freeze!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 这个如何？
items.text_en: Dodge this!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 小心着凉。
items.text_en: Don't get frostbite.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 抱歉哦。
items.text_en: Oh, so sorry!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: …这刹那，将是你的永恒。
items.text_en: This moment will be frozen in time.

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 真是急性子啊你。
items.text_en: What's the hurry?

items.title: 冲刺结束·其一
items.text: 呼，哈哈。
items.text_en: *pant* Haha.

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 起风了。
items.text_en: Catch the wind.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 运气还不错！
items.text_en: How fortunate!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 挺有趣的。
items.text_en: Fascinating.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 哈哈，真有乐子。
items.text_en: Haha, quite the find.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 看来该认真了。
items.text_en: Time to fight back, I s'pose.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 似乎变得无聊了…
items.text_en: I'm getting tired of this game.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 麻烦的家伙…
items.text_en: You're getting on my nerves...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 让我帮你吧，记得欠我一个人情。
items.text_en: I'll help out, but you owe me.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 喂，命丢了可就不好玩了。
items.text_en: Hey, don't die on me. That's no fun.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 还没尽…兴…
items.text_en: I'm not done...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 哼，意料之外…
items.text_en: That was unexpected...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 太难看了。
items.text_en: This doesn't look good...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 可恶…
items.text_en: Urgh!

items.title: 重受击·其二
items.text: 适可而止。
items.text_en: Don't push your luck!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 真期待啊。
items.text_en: Oh, I'm looking forward to this.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 去找点乐子吧。
items.text_en: This will be interesting.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 早就准备好喽。
items.text_en: Ready when you are.
